summary: Unified high-performance architecture with an integrated memory evaluation layer. Implemented semantic caching using sqlite-vec and binary quantization, reinforced by a 'RAGAS-lite' evaluation suite to ensure retrieval quality and prevent silent degradation during memory compression.
key_learnings: Binary Quantization and sqlite-vec facilitate high-performance vector storage with minimal overhead.
Quantitative evaluation (RAGAS-lite) is essential to detect signal loss during compression, preventing the noise inherent in pure vector similarity search.
System agility is best maintained by balancing robust concurrency/CI/CD workflows with lightweight, dependency-conscious architecture.
Strict semantic thresholds and hybrid search strategies are required to maintain system state freshness.
